newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-L.Lease sees financial services growth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-L.Lease sees financial services growth.

text.p: Property Lend Lease Corp Ltd managing director David Higgins said on Friday the company expected its financial services division to achieve double digit growth in sales and net profit within a three year period.
Higgins told a news conference the increases would be achieved through a 40 percent reduction in costs and the introduction of new and simplified financial services products.
Higgins said he could not quantify the rise Lend Lease expected in 1996/97 net profit as it was too early in the current year.
The forecast sales rise by financial services, which includes the MLC insurance and fund management operations, was based on the A$2.4 billion in sales for 1995/96, Higgins said.

He said the property and financial service company's 7.6 percent rise in 1995/96 net profit to A$280.0 million was a "strong result" as it had been achieved in a domestic environment of low growth and low inflation. This compared with analysts forecasts which ranged from A$273 to A$290 million.
Australia accounts for nearly 90 percent of earnings, with Higgins unable to predict how the geographic profit mix might change in the medium term. - Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
